entries.land_description: Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine. No bars, no TV, no swimming pool (though there is a lake near). Just a quiet retreat in a beautiful place.
entries.notes: Womyn's Guest House offering 3 rooms at reasonable rates. Seasonal - June thru Sept. Open year round.

entries.land_description: Laurel Ridge is a guest house for women on 18 beautiful acres of fields and woods in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea. We have/are: 18 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Our rates are very reasonable and our guests enjoy comfortable lodging and delicious home-cooked meals. There are domestic and farm animals about the place, as well as vegetable, herb, and flower gardens. Partial work exchange possible. Open year round. No drugs or alcohol.

entries.land_description: Vacation cabin in the Blue Mountains. 3-4 bedrooms which accommodate 7 persons, huge, cozy kitchen and enclosed porch. The cabin is in a private setting in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail and a short distance from Blue Marsh Recreation Area and PA Dutch country. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods.
entries.welcomed_groups: new residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs

entries.num_residents: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country
entries.land_description: We are a small lesbian residential community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. We have/are: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors
entries.notes: Only lesbians can rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Open year round. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in building. No pets, no nudity on our property or directly in front of us on the beach.

entries.street_address: c/o Nell Wagenaar & Rebecca Clark, Rt 1 Box 257
entries.land_description: Labrys is an inexpensive, synergetic wilderness resort for women located in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan. We have three cabins nestled among tall White Pine and Oak facing a sandy beach on Long Lake with dock and boats. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 acre, 3 cabins, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl children, boy children under 12, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: We are looking for women to invest in property here. Our dream is to make this end of Long Lake an all-woman community, with a possible campground, a quiet area for geese and heron nesting, more cabins and a community lodge for workshops, etc. Open year round.

entries.land_description: Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton, 2 hrs from St Louis. River Spirit Retreat is a scenic, secluded retreat for individuals and small groups by the Illinois River. Retreat caters to women, especially lesbians. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 14 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, camping space, women living part-time and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males
entries.notes: Open to alternative humanitarian types, counselors or small businesses needing retreat atmosphere. Proprietor is counselor and offers groups and retreats several times a year.
